title: CascadePSP: Toward Class-Agnostic and Very High-Resolution Segmentation via Global and Local Refinement
mechanism: A class-agnostic cascade refiner trained on perturbed masks that refines a mask globally and then locally, at any resolution.
adaptation: Inference-only test on inactive masks with the pretrained refiner (EL repeated to 3 channels); fine-tune on perturbed inactive GT if the zero-shot test is not negative.
min_experiment: Arm: CascadePSP on house / PF inactive masks. Baseline: unrefined. Metric: inactive IoU on 5-fold CV and E1. Kill: < +0.01 inactive IoU.
evidence: R: improved IoU and boundary accuracy on the BIG high-resolution set and PASCAL refinement benchmarks (numbers not read).

alt_notes.adaptation: Our cells are 512 px native and U-Net++ already predicts at full resolution, so its main benefit is absent; retrain on OOF masks per class only as a benchmark refinement baseline.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: CascadePSP retrained on OOF crack / inactive masks. Baseline: house ensemble. Metric: relF1@2, inactive IoU. Kill: no gain > +0.01 relF1@2 and +0.02 inactive IoU.
